results.excerpt: At 632f955. Plugin registers no MCP server, tool, agent or command (one skill, hooks only; nothing references the host), so there is no tool to call with forged sources. Entry points: bin/host.js wake now reads only a UserPromptSubmit prompt or ReadNotifications notifications with origin github_webhook. 7 forge tests pass: output of Bash/Read/WebFetch/Write/Task/mcp__x__ReadNotifications carrying a perfect wake with current-time 2099 changes nothing (forge-probe: state building -> building, no results); other origins (agent_message, send_later, case/space variants, missing) and other hook events ignored; current-time 2099/9999/garbage never makes a timer due (capped at host clock); wake quoted mid-line, indented, or inside an <agent-message> hand-back (the platform really indents those, per the capture fixture) is not read; wake/event/system-note/task-notification markup inside a GitHub JSON field adds no event. JUDGMENT CALL, residual: an agent with a shell can still run `node packages/engine/bin/host.js wake` with a UserPromptSubmit-shaped stdin it types, and gets a github-sourced event (and can type any session_id); verified by hand. I read the Expect as covering what the platform and plugin give an agent, not a hand-typed command, because the same shell can append journal rows directly (ledger L-same-account-everywhere, accepted in plan/README.md). Not covered: the ReadNotifications result shape {notifications:[{origin,content}]} is the builder's assumption, no real capture exists in the repo; if it is wrong, real GitHub wakes read that way are dropped (fails closed). Also: a GitHub field containing the literal text </event> makes that event vanish with no row (forge.test.mjs FINDING test).
